expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Staged plan M0–M5 with only M0 done ('M0 骨架（已完成）', M1–M5 unchecked); scaffold leaves work for learner: 'cycle() 留了译码惯例注释', 'main.cpp # 入口，M1/M2 的接入点已用 TODO 标出', '下一步是 M1：先把字体集（80 字节）写进 0x050，然后从最简单的 opcode 开始实现' — 35 opcodes not implemented, so it coaches rather than dumps the full implementation.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Runnable checkpoint with concrete command and expected behaviour: README 'cmake -B build / cmake --build build / ./build/chip8 <rom.ch8>   # M2 之前仅打印就绪信息'; answer reports '构建零警告，冒烟测试通过（正常 ROM 打印就绪、坏 ROM 报错退出）', verified by the run of ./build/chip8 with a test ROM and a nonexistent ROM.

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (emulator-virtual-machine-chip8-interpreter): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Milestones match the CHIP-8 tutorial's actual stages and concepts: '字体集、35 个 opcode、定时器', 'SDL2 渲染 64×32、16 键映射', 'DX/FX0A 的绘制/按键等待语义', 'CPU 频率节流（目标 ~600 op/s）', 'Timendus 测试套件、VF/移位行为差异（原始 COSMAC VIP vs CHIP-48/SUPER-CHIP）'; references Cowgod's Chip-8 Reference and the Laurence Muller COSMAC VIP article; C++17 CMake skeleton.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: No install commands were run, but the shell command writes outside the project dir: "printf '\x00\xE0\x00\xEE' > /tmp/test.rom" creates /tmp/test.rom outside the project directory, violating the workspace-only constraint.
